benchmark: PCOE Effect-Owner Payment Execution and Recovery

scenarios.threat: Same identity and same fingerprint, sequential retry
scenarios.preconditions: The first operation has a committed journal batch and response.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Retry with the exact same identity and fingerprint; attempt to create a second batch.
scenarios.required_control: Return the original operation and batch references; all journal legs and projections remain exactly one.

scenarios.threat: Same identity with altered semantic fingerprint
scenarios.preconditions: An operation identity is already bound to payer, beneficiary, amount, currency, purpose, source obligation and fee policy.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Change any bound semantic field while keeping the identity.
scenarios.required_control: Reject the altered request and preserve the original operation and all effects unchanged.

scenarios.threat: Concurrent same-identity requests on one payer chain
scenarios.preconditions: Two calls begin from the same source-chain head and carry the same identity and fingerprint.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Race both calls through claim and batch creation.
scenarios.required_control: At most one claim and one journal batch commit; losing call re-reads and returns the same result or remains indeterminate.

scenarios.threat: Same identity races from a second agent key
scenarios.preconditions: Two agent keys attempt to submit the same payer operation identity.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Use stale or conflicting DID-to-agent authority state to create a second batch.
scenarios.required_control: One authoritative payer key / chain must be established. Alternate-key ambiguity blocks rather than authorizing a second effect.

scenarios.threat: A staged local debit is followed by a local credit failure inside the same Finance zome call
scenarios.preconditions: The sender debit, beneficiary credit, Payment and Receipt writes occur during one Finance Payments zome-function invocation on the same source chain.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Inject a host or validation error after the debit helper is called but before the credit helper completes; incorrectly assume only the debit can persist.
scenarios.required_control: Holochain's same-source-chain zome-call atomicity must roll back every staged Finance record together. A real-agent test must assert unchanged payer / beneficiary balances and no Payment / Receipt record after the failed call.

scenarios.threat: Treasury fee delivery commits before the Finance source-chain transaction
scenarios.preconditions: Finance synchronously calls the separate Treasury cell before creating its Payment and Receipt records.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Let Treasury accept the fee, then force a later Finance-side error or source-chain commit failure.
scenarios.required_control: Do not dispatch Treasury delivery before the Finance journal / outbox commits. Commit a durable fee outbox item with the local Finance batch, then dispatch using a Treasury-owned idempotency identity and reconcile its exact receipt.

scenarios.threat: Finance commits then response is lost
scenarios.preconditions: The complete batch is durably committed, but Energy times out before receiving the response.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Retry the original identity and fingerprint.
scenarios.required_control: Return the exact original batch/payment references; debit, credit and fee liability counts remain one.

scenarios.threat: Response lost before Finance claim commits
scenarios.preconditions: The caller cannot tell whether the request reached the effect owner.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Retry using the same identity and fingerprint.
scenarios.required_control: Resolve the original identity; one commit at most. If commit status is not yet authoritative, return Indeterminate and do not mint a new identity.

scenarios.threat: Treasury unavailable after fee liability commit
scenarios.preconditions: The local journal batch includes one fee liability and an outbox item; Treasury is unavailable.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Retry fee delivery with the original outbox identity.
scenarios.required_control: Preserve the fee liability and pending outbox; do not erase the fee or create a fresh fee operation identity.

scenarios.threat: Treasury accepts fee but response is lost
scenarios.preconditions: Treasury may have committed delivery even though Finance received no response.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Query or retry the same Treasury-owned outbox identity.
scenarios.required_control: Treasury resolves the same identity to the original effect; no duplicate fee delivery.

scenarios.threat: Client idempotency cache expired after a committed payment
scenarios.preconditions: The short-lived transport cache entry has expired, but the durable journal batch and operation tombstone remain.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Re-use the old identity with the same or changed fingerprint.
scenarios.required_control: Never treat cache expiry as permission to execute again; resolve the original batch or reject stale reuse.

scenarios.threat: Finance conductor restarts after commit before response
scenarios.preconditions: The source chain contains the complete batch, but in-memory cache state is lost.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Restart and retry the original identity.
scenarios.required_control: Reconstruct disposition and exact references from durable source-chain evidence, not volatile process memory.

scenarios.threat: DHT partition or delayed gossip hides an existing operation
scenarios.preconditions: A remote read does not yet expose the committed operation record.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Attempt a second same-key operation based only on a missing DHT link.
scenarios.required_control: A missing link is not proof of absence; rely on effect-owner authority/source-chain state or remain Indeterminate.

scenarios.preconditions: Two calls race a source-chain head or a restored/forked agent attempts to append.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Retry using a fresh identity or accept both sibling histories.
scenarios.required_control: Do not create a new economic identity to bypass the old one; only one authoritative chain/effect owner outcome may be accepted.

scenarios.threat: Fee formula or integer arithmetic overflow
scenarios.preconditions: Fee calculation, payer debit, beneficiary credit and fee allocation use an exact versioned integer policy.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Overflow, use a floating-point amount, or change fee policy version under same identity.
scenarios.required_control: Reject invalid amount/policy before journal commit; require debit = credit + fee exactly.

scenarios.preconditions: A projection worker processes the same committed journal batch repeatedly.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Create extra Payment or Receipt records / duplicate links on replay.
scenarios.required_control: Projection identity is the journal batch identity; replay must converge to one deterministic projection and must not mutate balances.

scenarios.preconditions: The request has a valid operation identity but the authenticated author or beneficiary differs from the fingerprint.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Submit as a different payer or mutate beneficiary on retry.
scenarios.required_control: Validate the author and exact beneficiary at the Finance commit boundary; no effect is committed.

scenarios.threat: Internal SAP ledger commit is presented as external payment finality
scenarios.preconditions: Finance has a complete internal SAP ledger journal batch but no bank / payment-rail receipt.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Promote internal Payment Completed or a local receipt to external PaidFinal.
scenarios.required_control: Represent internal LedgerCommitted separately from external rail finality, physical delivery and contract acceptance.

scenarios.threat: post_commit wake-up is lost after a Finance batch commits
scenarios.preconditions: A Finance journal batch and Pending Treasury outbox record are committed on the source chain, but the process crashes before a post_commit callback dispatches the outbox.
scenarios.adversarial_mutation: Rely only on an in-memory callback or notification and never scan the durable outbox after restart.
scenarios.required_control: A restart-safe scanner reconstructs pending outbox work from committed source-chain records and dispatches with the same Treasury operation identity; the callback is only a wake-up hint.
